agent_explanation: Actuated control with detector_fail on W approach causes EW green to be held indefinitely beyond max_green_seconds (66s). NS has been red since ~603s, so N/S queues grow and wait exceeds 200s. Failure starts at t=636 while EW green is active; controller treats failed detector as no queue for gap-out but also fails to enforce max-green or demand recall, so EW never yields. Removing detector_fail restores normal cycling and no max_wait violation.
